name: TyresAddict – Promotion for Woo
author: TyresAddict

sections.description:
This plugin supports promotion actions and discounts in store with Elementor widgets, badges, blocks and UI for manage promotions. Engage & maintain interest of your customers in your products until purchase!

Promotion allows you to manage product promotions in your store and post promotional information. It support visual part of promotions only.

Use metadata for management, Elementor for widgets.

Required Plugins:

  • WooCommerce
  • Metabox
  • Elementor (very recommended, but technically not required)

Main Features:

  • Support badges: product cards, at cart
  • Support promo blocks on product pages
  • Elementor widget for promotions
  • Promoted products by categories

sections.installation:
Requires WooCommerce, Metabox and Elementor plugins

  1. Install the plugin either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Why icons not shows?

Use Awesome font for icons. You can install it any method, using theme or plugin.
